scope: Independent environment rendering/layout preview only. Not a production navigation, mining or battle benchmark.

source_resources.normal_convention: Unverified, original pixels retained without green flip. Close/middle/far screenshots visually inspected; no obvious deformation or inverted relief, but this does not establish the exporter convention.

timing_note: Each route region has eleven samples of 180 measured frames after 60 warmup frames. Measurements include 60 Hz waiting and real slow frames; do not infer guaranteed FPS or combat performance. Earlier locked-screen spikes remain in prior reports.
limitations: Winter/snow and desert regional vegetation sources remain unavailable; no replacement models invented.
